open_points.subject: perform_service_operation
open_points.text: perform_service_operation: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that a call of an operation the imported SERVICE_RIGHTS constant does not give the calling service is refused with OUTSIDE_SERVICE_RIGHTS before any module is called and changes nothing: the CABINET member reading a customer's billing data, the PRESUPRO member publishing an artifact pointer and the CABINET_KERNEL member reading a project's context; that a token held by no service is refused with NO_VALID_TOKEN exactly as a wrong one; that a repeat of a create carrying an earlier request id is refused so too, never answered as a repeat; and that only a call of the CABINET_KERNEL member acts with an ActingPrincipal of the AGENT_VIA_KERNEL member of = models.PrincipalKind, a call of any other service never acting for an agent session.
open_points.other_text: from app.data_provider import OWNER_AUDIT_ACTIONS, PERSONAL_DATA_FIELDS, REFUSAL_STAGE_AGENT_SESSION, REFUSAL_STAGE_AUTHENTICATION, REFUSAL_STAGE_VALUES, SERVICE_AGENT_SESSION_HEADER
open_points.question: Must SERVICE_RIGHTS be added to IMPORTS and the imported data access signatures, or must the note stop naming it as an imported constant?

open_points.subject: _answer_class
open_points.text: _answer_class: [BEHAVIOR] MUST answer the PERSONAL_DATA member of = models.DisclosureClass when, in answer or in any model nested in it at any depth, a field that the imported PERSONAL_DATA_FIELDS constant lists for that model's name holds a value other than None and other than an empty tuple, and the BUSINESS_CONFIDENTIAL member otherwise, never the OPEN member; walking answer it MUST tell a model from any other value by isinstance against the pydantic base model class, take its fields by iterating the model, which yields each field's name and value in their declared order, and take a tuple's elements in their order, never with hasattr, getattr, setattr or vars and never through __dict__ or model_dump, and name a model by the name of its class.
open_points.rule: Реализацию: не пиши алгоритм построчно, пиши требования к поведению
open_points.question: The note must state the classification and traversal requirements without prescribing the step-by-step implementation operations used to walk models and tuples.

open_points.subject: _confirmation_inputs
open_points.text: _confirmation_inputs: [FALLBACK] MUST answer NoConfirmationInputs when a value the inputs of its action need is None or erase_before is not text of four ASCII digits, a hyphen, two ASCII digits, a hyphen and two ASCII digits that names a real calendar date by its year, month and day, so that a submission missing one is never bound to a step that showed it.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: The inline date micro-syntax must be replaced by a named imported policy constant or an appropriate declared validation contract.

open_points.subject: OwnerActionStep.run
open_points.text: OwnerActionStep.run: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST answer through _refused, calling no module, a Refusal with the INVALID_REQUEST member of = models.RefusalCode at the stage the imported REFUSAL_STAGE_VALUES constant names when a value the action's module needs is None, with one failure of the MISSING_VALUE member of = models.RefusalKind whose path is one PathElement naming target or the field of = models.OwnerValues that lacks it, and when end_date or erase_before is not text of four ASCII digits, a hyphen, two ASCII digits, a hyphen and two ASCII digits that names a real calendar date by its year, month and day, with one failure of the OUTSIDE_FORM member naming that field; given facts or a pointer not given MUST be handed on with every field None, so that their module refuses their missing values.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: The inline date micro-syntax must be replaced by a named imported policy constant or an appropriate declared validation contract.

open_points.subject: perform_service_operation
open_points.text: perform_service_operation: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST run one ServiceCallStep of that call on the store opened_store gives, through run_in_transaction when agent_authority is true or the operation's note on ServiceCallStep.run calls it a change, and through read_in_transaction otherwise, and MUST answer what that run answers, adding no check after the step's.
open_points.rule: подмножество членов, задающее категорию, — allow-list. Код читает их как константу поставщика данных (§15.3.1, §6.10), а не как прозу рядом с `= models.X`.
open_points.question: The set of service operations classified as changes must be supplied through an imported provider constant instead of being inferred from other notes.

open_points.subject: OwnerRequestStep.run
open_points.text: OwnerRequestStep.run: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST answer every other action by running one OwnerActionStep of a PreparedOwnerAction of the request, session_id, the instant recorded_now gives once, the date _today_of gives for it and whether a confirmation was taken, and with the body the step holds as its body, on the store opened_store gives, through run_in_transaction when the action's note on OwnerActionStep.run calls it a change and through read_in_transaction otherwise, and answer what that run answers.
open_points.rule: подмножество членов, задающее категорию, — allow-list. Код читает их как константу поставщика данных (§15.3.1, §6.10), а не как прозу рядом с `= models.X`.
open_points.question: The set of owner actions classified as changes must be supplied through an imported provider constant instead of being inferred from other notes.

open_points.subject: OwnerActionStep.run
open_points.text: OwnerActionStep.run: [BEHAVIOR] After an accepted change MUST append, in transaction and through append_audit_entry, one entry of the audit action _audit_action_of gives for the action and its values' transition and erasure, when it gives one, the change answered changed true or the action being ERASE_AUDIT_ENTRIES, and, for GRANT_PROJECT and ANSWER_ACCESS_REQUEST, its AccessChanged answering project_joined true, so that making a granted project active, granting it again, declining a request or answering one by granting a project already in the set appends none: with the owner's ActingPrincipal, the instant, as subject the project for a project's action, the customer for a customer's, the session and the project for a grant or revocation, the file digest for the import and none for the erasure of old entries, the erased date for that erasure, and a confirmation id from mint_identity for a confirmed action, the import's being the one its closure holds; a refusal, a repeat answered changed false and a read MUST append none and mint none.
open_points.rule: Таблица — это когда по члену перечисления выбирается значение: член другого перечисления, код, категория.
open_points.question: The mapping from owner-action categories to audit-subject forms must be placed in provider data and named through an imported constant rather than encoded as prose in the note.
